aboutGame.title: What is Giggleland?
paragraphs: Giggleland is a first-person psychological horror game set in an amusement park where cheerful mascots and visitor rules hide a much darker story. Players guide Tolie, a silent child searching for her missing father, through eight chapters that move from Farmer Terry's farm to the tunnels beneath the park.

The game combines environmental exploration, puzzle-solving, hidden clues, and a fully voice-acted cast across roughly six hours. A free demo, Giggleland: Terry's Vegetable Patch, is available on Steam ahead of the October 26, 2026 release.

modules.name: Giggleland Beginner Guide
modules.description: Learn controls, setup priorities, early exploration, and the habits that make Giggleland's first two hours smoother.

highlights.detail: Rebind anything you fumble, turn on subtitles, and raise effects above music.
Complete the intro without skipping; it teaches the interaction verbs used all game.
Walk the first area and name three landmarks to build navigation memory.
Practice one weapon or ability in a low-risk area before a tense encounter.
Pickups, diaries, and environment text carry puzzle clues and story context.
Return to locked doors and side rooms after every new item or key.

highlights.detail: Park signage hides names, dates, and symbols used by later puzzles.
Check shelves, drawers, and desks for notes, diaries, and key items.

items.question: What is Giggleland?
items.answer: Giggleland is a first-person psychological horror game set in an amusement park. Players guide Tolie through eight chapters as she searches for her missing father, solving environmental puzzles and uncovering the history behind the park's cheerful mascots.

items.question: Is there a Giggleland demo?
items.answer: Yes. Giggleland: Terry's Vegetable Patch is a free standalone demo available on Steam, and it includes a complete story with its own ending.

items.question: When does Giggleland release?
items.answer: Giggleland is scheduled to launch on October 26, 2026 for Windows PC through Steam.

items.question: How long is Giggleland?
items.answer: The Giggleland campaign runs for about six hours across eight chapters, moving from Farmer Terry's farm to the tunnels beneath the park.

items.question: Who is the main character in Giggleland?
items.answer: Tolie is the silent protagonist of Giggleland. She searches for her missing father while Eliot serves as her cheerful park guide.

items.question: Can I stream Giggleland?
items.answer: Yes. Giggleland is safe to stream and record without a streamer mode, provided you capture the game window instead of your entire desktop.
